blurb: Guests can experience the sights and sounds of American airpower aboard historic aircraft. The museum hosts monthly programs for all ages and special events such as the Texas Aviation Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony. Exhibits include a new exhibition honoring lives lost and acts of courage following September 11, 2001.
